name: 吧台调饮风味糖浆多用途款

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white studio stage #FFFFFF for packshots, deep charcoal matte board #191614 for the graphic screens with a glossy caramel-orange #F08A16 pour band, lime-washed teal wall #7FB6BD and warm dark counter #241E1A for scenes
styleLock.lightingSystem: neutral high-key studio light, large front-left softbox key with a fill card, thin sweeping rim travelling along the glass shoulder, soft honest contact shadows, never harsh or dramatic
styleLock.surfaceSystem: whitewashed timber table #E6DED5, pale limestone ledge #F1EDE7, dark timber serving tray #3A2F27, charcoal slate #1C1917
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one family only, one short headline plus five short label lines maximum, all wording carried by placeholders
styleLock.iconSystem: single-weight thin-line glyphs centred inside solid caramel-orange #F08A16 discs, outline only, no letters, no digits, no certification or religious seals
styleLock.presentationRules: tall slim bottle kept upright, glossy and unclipped at a stable slight 3/4 or straight-on hero angle with constant scale; finished drinks read as food, never as plastic; every label panel, badge, seal, table cell and colour strip stays blank and unprinted
noDrift: no printed numbers, units, flavour names or nutrition values anywhere
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium barista-syrup gastronomy visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white stage #FFFFFF, deep charcoal board #191614, caramel-orange accent #F08A16 and indigo syrup blue #1D3C8C; neutral high-key studio lighting with a large front-left softbox key, fill card, thin sweeping rim along the glass shoulder and soft honest contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif in one family; single-weight thin-line glyphs inside solid caramel-orange discs only; tall slim bottle always upright, glossy and at a stable slight 3/4 or straight-on hero angle with constant scale; every label panel, badge, seal, table cell and colour strip stays blank and unprinted; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：图1 近纯白底上细高玻璃瓶直立，深色浆液、黑色螺旋盖、蓝色颈标与黑底标签带滴落图形，右下两颗染成蓝色的树莓道具，无任何图内营销文字；图2 同瓶背面直立，瓶背为营养成分表双栏、配料文字块、社媒账号字样、网址与条码，均为密集印刷文字；图3 暗调黑板底、左上焦糖橙滴落色带，深色木托盘上一只透明玻璃杯奶咖与一支金属吧勺，右侧四行英文标题与短句，右下角品牌字标；图4 顶部焦糖橙色带加大滴落，深黑板上一字排开的五枚橙色圆底线性图标（瓶、甘蔗、奶罐、圆形符号、地图针）与每枚下方英文标签，右下角同一杯奶咖；图5 顶部焦糖橙色带，深黑板上一行英文大标题与两行含按压用量数字的说明，下方两列三行六枚橙色圆底图标配英文标签（热饮、茶、冰沙、汽水柠檬水、鸡尾酒无酒精饮、烘焙），右下角同一杯奶咖；图6 石灰刷青绿墙与漂白木桌，一只人手（仅见前臂）托白色锥形纸杯装的亮蓝色刨冰并插两根条纹吸管，桌面蓝白格纸巾上三颗红树莓；图7 同一场景加入直立瓶身置于左侧，手托锥形杯在右。品类判定：主产品为玻璃瓶装浓缩风味糖浆，图3 至图7 的落点全部是稀释调饮（热奶咖、冰饮、气泡、刨冰），属需冲调使用的浓缩浆，不是开盖即饮的瓶装饮料，也不是入菜的咸味酱汁或生鲜粮油，故判食品饮料/冲调；提示类目为源平台食品杂货大类，与源类目文字不作逐字对齐。已剥离内容：品牌字标与系列名、瓶身与图内一切口味名称及天然与人工香料字样、零糖与无糖类主张、甘蔗糖原料与宗教及产地类认证符号（圆形认证标记、地图针产地标记均改为空白印章框与同族通用线性图标）、两年保质期数字、按压用量与容量盎司毫升等全部数值、图内四组英文标题与原句（改为 「{selling_point_1}」 与 「{callout_1}」 至 「{callout_5}」 占位）、瓶背营养成分表与配料全部数值与文字（改为空参数行、空白单元格、空线块）、条码与二维码与原平台店铺社媒账号字样、染蓝树莓道具（改为普通新鲜红树莓）、持杯者手臂的身份特征（改为通用成人手部且不出镜面部）；产品在所有分镜中均以 {product} 占位，图6 与图7 合并为一镜，图4 与图5 的图标语法分别拆为用途俯拍与信任收口两镜。
